title: Preserve three UW stock component references when correcting the borax owner identity
body:
The unpublished borax proposal `KG26-PROP-175-STRUCTURAL-IDENTITY` changes `Na2b4o7_X_10_H2o.yaml` from `CHEBI:131366` to the reviewed supplied-form identity `CHEBI:38888`. A native full-catalog probe shows that three existing `MIM_CATALOG` component references still point to the retired identifier:

- `UW_Concentrated_Base.yaml`, component 11.
- `UW_Concentrated_Base_No_Mo.yaml`, component 10.
- `UW_Concentrated_Base_No_Sulfur.yaml`, component 11.

Each component is labelled sodium tetraborate decahydrate at 0.0177 g/L. Their source assertions cite the corresponding CultureBotHT `Mixes` rows. Review those intended ingredient references against their source and the corrected owner before changing them.

The unchanged native `component_partonomy` validator gives zero violations on the baseline, three unresolved-reference violations with the borax proposal alone, three with all 76 frozen proposals, and zero with the other 75 proposals. This establishes the dependency failure independently of the chemical-identity review.

Prepare guarded, provenance-preserving corrections for the three dependent records where their source supports the same borax identity. Preserve component positions, quantities, all other material inputs and historical assertions; append curation evidence/history. This is not a global redirect between ChEBI ontology entities and must not renew inherited mapping, role or component approval merely through bookkeeping.

Require zero violations from the unchanged native full-catalog validator, regression coverage for the three dependencies, and independent scientific/native re-review of the resulting proposals. Do not weaken the gate or revert to an unsupported identity to obtain a pass. If a source genuinely prevents correction, retain a precise unresolved dependency rather than guessing.

Evidence: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/w01-shard-native-integration-v1/finding-orphaned-component-references-v1.json`, SHA256 `2342b9260218ccea2be8c08a05db814fcf70c4af493cd006b79a7d92a856b119`; full private integration result SHA256 `aff3cc80b34a53586b2709d2e99255d2d756f299c92c82c5da8cb1aaa7fd86a5`. The finding binds the exact proposal, all three preimage hashes and native causality controls. No maintained or worker files changed during the probe.

Current open-issue deduplication found no tracker for these three new dependency failures. This finding belongs to the campaign evidence for #1160, with unchanged dependency #1158.
